newsitem.title: USA: A.H.Belo completes Providence Journal merger.
newsitem.headline: A.H.Belo completes Providence Journal merger.

text.p: A.H. Belo Corp said Friday it has completed the merger of The Providence Journal Co.
An agreement to purchase The Journal was announced on Sept 26 and approved by shareholders of both companies on Feb 19. The Federal Communications Commission approved the transaction today.
Belo also said it named four directors of The Providence Journal Co to its board of directors, effective May 14.
Stephen Hamblett and Peter Freeman will serve as directors until May 1998. Fanchon Burnham will serve as a director until May 1999. Henry Becton will serve as a director until May 2000.
